gaps.explanation: p5 (printed p18) Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds. (1) Missing fund column: the 'Other Fund (Keno)' column has no schedule and none of its lines are in detail[]: Lottery proceeds 38,808 and Interest income 1,062 (column Total revenues 39,870); added as fund 'Keno Fund'. (2) Different basis, 57,898: the Street, Sales Tax and Debt Service budgetary comparison schedules (pp10-12, in detail) print other actual amounts than the GAAP statement columns: Street 576,883 vs schedule 579,280 (Sales tax 127,403 vs Sales 129,800) = -2,397; Sales Tax 565,551 vs 512,783 (Sales tax 338,200 vs 285,432) = +52,768; Debt Service 1,046,173 vs 1,038,646 (Property 531,327 vs 531,915; Sales tax 241,670 vs 233,555) = +7,527; total 57,898. These are the same rows on two bases; adding the statement figures would count the money twice. General Fund (departments pp14-17, 1,937,456) and Capital Projects (p13, 397,428) tie. Check: 4,465,593 + 38,808 + 1,062 = 4,505,463; 4,563,361 - 4,505,463 = 57,898 = basis difference.
